title: fix: restore terminal and transcript lint limits after integration
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the terminal-test and transcript-projection max-lines failures reintroduced when a later integration undid their earlier repair.

## User Impact

No intended runtime or visual change. This restores passing lint without changing limits, adding suppressions, dropping assertions, or undoing the private-result publication fix.

## Why This Change Was Made

Restores the exact three-file change from [#161826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161826), which [#161820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161820) reversed in these paths. The auth cases return to their sibling test file with the same mocks and reset lifecycle; transcript recap ownership again uses its existing map instead of duplicate state.

Current input blobs match the earlier repair’s parent, and all three restored output blobs match that landed repair. The unrelated private-result publication changes remain intact.

## Evidence

- Reproduced both current lint errors: 1,056 counted lines against 1,000, and 701 against 700.
- Corrected exact lint scope: **0 errors, 0 warnings**, 3 files, 14.7 seconds.
- **108/108 focused tests passed** across 8 files: 70 terminal cases and 38 projection cases; 5 native shards, 74.95 seconds wrapper wall time. Existing auth tests were moved, not duplicated or added.
- Independent P2 review: no findings. All 24 native scoped checks passed, including the nine selected core-test type graphs, UI types, formatting, typed lint, and unchanged ratchets.
- Scoped local evidence only; the full main baseline remains incomplete.

Requested by @steipete through the ongoing CI monitoring task; this restores the earlier Peter Steinberger-authored repair.
